items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT in Sunday morning fantasy injury summary.
items.implication: Ravens backup QB and pass-catchers elevated; Jackson managers scramble.
items.opportunity: Increased volume for zay-flowers, mark-andrews, derrick-henry if game script allows.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT.
items.implication: Eagles WR room depleted for MNF; TE and remaining WRs surge.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes for dallas-goedert and secondary WRs; Saquon if active benefits.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after ankle turn on slide; would have been tilting if real injury while not scoring.
Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turned on purposeful slide; watching.
items.opportunity: If limited, montgomery or others rise (none primary listed).

items.text: Christian McCaffrey to locker room then returned (quad/thigh).
items.opportunity: Snap share held; SF WR outs (Evans/Deebo) already boosting.

items.text: Actives include Tank Dell, Jordan Mason; also Jacobs/Kirk/Coleman expected.
items.why: Official actives list and prior activations.

items.text: Puka Nacua GTD with optimism in morning summary after calf issue.
items.why: Calf; feeling better Saturday per sources.
items.implication: High-upside WR1 if active; have backup ready for late window.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected if cleared; reverse if inactive for other Rams WRs.

items.text: Breece Hall GTD with pessimism in morning summary.
items.why: Quad strain return attempt after missing games.
items.implication: Lean sit; committee or full backup likely.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup RB volume spike if inactive.

items.why: Hamstring; full participant Saturday signals return for MNF.
items.implication: RB1 upside if cleared; monitor final.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/carries/snap share rebound; complements WR outs.

items.implication: Packers RB volume restores; start with caution post-layoff.

items.text: Cam Skattebo expected to resume lead RB role vs Texans; later 124 yards on 17 carries + TD.
items.opportunity: High carries, goal-line, snap share as clear lead.

items.text: Late Sunday watches: CMC returned, Waddle shoulder, Gainwell hip returned, Skattebo/Tracy hamstring, others.
items.implication: Most returned or minor; monitor ROS for Waddle/Gainwell.
items.opportunity: No major immediate role flips beyond known.

items.implication: Matchup upgrade for Cardinals pass game (Marvin Harrison Jr etc).
